::: {#sol-training-flops}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
chinchilla_params, chinchilla_tokens = 70e9, 1.4e12
chinchilla_flops = 6 * chinchilla_params * chinchilla_tokens
tokens_per_param = chinchilla_tokens / chinchilla_params
print(f"{chinchilla_flops:.2e}", tokens_per_param)
```

About $`r sprintf("%.1f", py$chinchilla_flops / 1e23)` \times 10^{23}$ FLOPs.
Each token costs about 6 operations per [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter):
2 for the multiply and add of the forward pass,
and about 4 for the backward pass,
which takes about twice the computation of the forward pass [@kaplan2020scaling, section 2.1].
Chinchilla saw `r py$tokens_per_param` tokens for each of its [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter).

:::
